review_locator: PMID:27125737, The FGF21 Receptor Signaling Complex: Klothoβ, FGFR1c, and Other Regulatory Interactions; PMID:30455427, The Klotho proteins in health and disease
primary_title: betaKlotho is required for fibroblast growth factor (FGF) 21 signaling through FGF receptor (FGFR) 1c and FGFR3c
decision_basis: The reviews identify beta-Klotho-dependent FGFR3c as an FGF21-responsive receptor branch; the cited primary reconstitution study demonstrates FGF21-dependent receptor activation in BaF3 cells coexpressing FGFR3c and beta-Klotho.
limitations_preserved: Preserve beta-Klotho dependence, FGFR3c splice isoform, heparin enhancement, and reconstituted/metabolic-cell context; no transfer to FGFR1c or SCI and no terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMID:18926762, Structures and biological functions of IL-31 and IL-31 receptors; PMCID:PMC7902767, Interleukin-31 Signaling Bridges the Gap Between Immune Cells, the Nervous System and Epithelial Tissues
primary_title: Interleukin 31, a cytokine produced by activated T cells, induces dermatitis in mice; Regulation of myeloid progenitor cell proliferation/survival by IL-31 receptor and IL-31
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL31RA/OSMRbeta as the functional IL-31 receptor; the cited primary studies show IL-31-dependent proliferation in receptor-reconstituted BaF3 cells and IL-31R/OSMR-dependent hematopoietic responses.
limitations_preserved: Preserve IL31RA isoform, OSMRbeta shared-subunit topology, species-specific ligand activity, and immune/epithelial comparator context; no gp130 substitution, SCI transfer, or terminal-TF inference.
